admission.justification: Metadata and selected feature discovery use separate entry points, which keeps every listed model selectable without querying options for every pair.

applicability: The dashboard role launcher’s shown-model option lookup.
conditions: The metadata generation is current and the pane has a provider and model selection.
A held answer for the pair is reused through selection and post-Start metadata rereads until Refresh.
exclusions: Start itself can check its resolved model and validate supplied features during creation.

evidence: Mounted option tests carried from W2 by dashboard tree parity and unchanged-bridge wire proof in the W1 archive, validated for F08. CUR-F01 guide-to-source comparison and current mounted tests.

statement: The panel lists the catalogue and requests options for only its current provider and model, keeping each answer until Refresh.
